# Classic Bar Unofficial v1.5.5

Spells & Shields mana bar support, configurable state icons, and a set of fixes.

## Spells & Shields compatibility
- Mana bar with six state icons: `mana_full`, `mana_full_blinking`, `mana_leaking`, `mana_leaking_blinking`, `mana_extra`, `mana_extra_blinking` — each composited (fixed base + overlay) from Spells & Shields' own sprite sheet, credited under MIT.
- Icons switch on state: the counter fades to the leaking variant while Spells & Shields' leaking effect drains mana, and shows the extra variant while bonus mana is held. Flash frames follow the mod's own mana-change timer.
- The main fill switches to a dedicated leaking colour while draining. New `general.mana_leaking_bar_color` (#77AE88 by default) plus the existing main and extra colour keys are all configurable.
- The bar's icon, mode, text format and colour overlay are configurable like every other bar, and the old `mana.png` placeholder has been removed (point `bars.mana.icon` at `mana_full.png` if you had set it explicitly).

## Fixes
- **F1 now hides every ClassicBar bar.** The bar layer is registered outside the vanilla hideGui scope, so it previously kept drawing while the rest of the HUD was hidden.
- Removed legacy duplicate top-level config keys; config entries live under `general.*`.

## Localization
- English and Chinese are back in lockstep (330 keys each), the per-bar label template is consistent across all 11 bars, and the NeoForge config-screen keys are present.
- Wording that merely said "reserved / no effect in this build" now describes the actual behaviour.

## Development
- NeoForge 21.1.248, Farmer's Delight 1.3.4, Kaleidoscope Cookery 1.4.1, Vampirism 1.10.13, EnigmaticLegacy+ 1.0.0; JEI is now pinned explicitly, fixing a `NoSuchMethodError` from the Kaleidoscope Cookery JEI plugin.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.228+
- Client-side only
- Spells & Shields mana support requires NeoForge 21.1.233+ (Spells & Shields' own requirement)
